menu:3133270:1.text: Why isn't the courier here yet?

say:1:1123649001:1.text: There's a batch of baby terrabirds we needed to deliver to the Eroded Enclave, but the transportation hit a snag halfway through.
say:1:1123649001:1.source_cn: 黑嚎氏族有一批陆行鸟幼崽要运送到风蚀飞地，但没想到居然...

say:2:1123649002:1.text: Now, the courier is stuck at the <style="highlight">border between the Ashen Wastes and the Eroded Enclave</style>. He desperately needs help.

say:3:1123649003:1.text: We're too shorthanded to send help at the moment. You're the only one I can count on.
say:3:1123649003:1.source_cn: 氏族里暂时抽不出人手。只能麻烦你过去协助他们了。
say:3:1123649003:1.male: We're too shorthanded to send help at the moment. You're the only one I can count on.
say:3:1123649003:1.female: We're too shorthanded to send help at the moment. You're the only one I can count on.

say:0:1123650001:0.text: Help! Help! Our <style="highlight">baby terrabirds</style> have escaped!
say:0:1123650001:0.source_cn: 帮帮忙，帮帮忙！我们货车上的<style=highli...

say:1:1123650002:0.text: Our delivery can't be delayed any longer!
say:1:1123650002:0.source_cn: 交货时间马上就要到了，不能再耽误了！

say:0:1123651001:0.text: *Sigh*... We've got them all back. It's finally time to hit the road again.
say:0:1123651001:0.source_cn: 呼……总算都抓回来，可以继续赶路了。

say:1:1123651002:0.text: But I heard there are <style="highlight">wolves</style> ahead. Could you get rid of them? Otherwise, these babies will be in danger.
say:1:1123651002:0.source_cn: 不过我听说前面经常有<style=highlight>...
say:1:1123651002:0.male: But I heard there are <style="highlight">wolves</style> ahead. Could you get rid of them? Otherwise, these babies will be in danger.
say:1:1123651002:0.female: But I heard there are <style="highlight">wolves</style> ahead. Could you get rid of them? Otherwise, these babies will be in danger.

say:2:1123651003:0.text: <style="highlight">The merchant who buys these terrabirds</style> is also in that area. Please tell her we're almost there.
say:2:1123651003:0.male: <style="highlight">The merchant who buys these terrabirds</style> is also in that area. Please tell her we're almost there.
say:2:1123651003:0.female: <style="highlight">The merchant who buys these terrabirds</style> is also in that area. Please tell her we're almost there.

say:0:1123652001:0.text: There should be no more wolves left. Let's go and find the merchant who trades with the Grimmaws.
say:0:1123652001:0.source_cn: 附近应该没有其他野狼了。去前面找和黑嚎交易的商人吧。
say:0:1123652001:0.male: There should be no more wolves left. Let's go and find the merchant who trades with the Grimmaws.
say:0:1123652001:0.female: Nice! No more wolves! Let's go find the merchant.

say:1:1123653001:1.text: The terrabirds ran away earlier? ... Don't the Grimmaw Clan have beast tamers?
say:1:1123653001:1.source_cn: 哈？小陆行鸟跑出来了？\n……黑嚎的人不懂驯兽吗？

say:2:1123653002:1.text: Anyway, you can just leave the birds to me. I'm a bird-taming expert. As long as I have this <style="highlight">whistle</style>...
say:2:1123653002:1.source_cn: 算了算了，这些鸟交给我就放心吧，我可是驯鸟好手！只要有...

say:3:1123653003:1.text: ... Wait a minute. Where's my <style="highlight">whistle</style>? It was in my bag just now!

say:4:1123653004:1.text: The Grimmaw Clan is going to be here any minute! Don't just stand there! Hurry up and help me look for my whistle!
say:4:1123653004:1.source_cn: 黑嚎的人马上就到了！你也别愣着，赶紧帮我一起找吧！
say:4:1123653004:1.male: The Grimmaw Clan is going to be here any minute! Don't just stand there! Hurry up and help me look for my whistle!
say:4:1123653004:1.female: The Grimmaw Clan is going to be here any minute! Don't just stand there! Hurry up and help me look for my whistle!

say:1:1123654001:1.text: Thank goodness! I thought I lost my whistle. Thank you.
say:1:1123654001:1.source_cn: 谢天谢地，还好没把哨子弄丢。\n也多谢你了。
say:1:1123654001:1.male: Thank goodness! I thought I lost my whistle. Thank you.
say:1:1123654001:1.female: Thank goodness! I thought I lost my whistle. Thank you.

say:3:1123654002:1.text: Sorry for being late! These baby terrabirds are such a handful.
say:3:1123654002:1.source_cn: ——我来晚了！真是不好意思，都怪这群小陆行鸟太闹腾了。

say:4:1123654003:1.text: Please be rest assured. They're all in tip-top shape. We raised them with utmost care!
say:4:1123654003:1.source_cn: 不过你也放心，这些鸟崽子都是我们黑嚎氏族精心饲养的，保...

say:5:1123654004:1.text: But you kept me waiting for a long time. Surely, we can renegotiate the price, right?
say:5:1123654004:1.source_cn: 但你耽误了我这么久的时间——价格总还有得商量吧？

say:6:1123654005:1.text: What? Didn't we already agree on the price?
say:6:1123654005:1.source_cn: 什、什么？！价格不是早就谈好了吗？！
